_source: Ministry of Education / Curriculum Development Centre, Zambia. 'Grade 10-12 Geography Syllabus' (2013, published by CDC), Section D (Zambia) — all of Grade 12. Outcome text and order manually traced against each sub-topic heading, cross-checked against the syllabus's own end-of-document Scope and Sequence Chart. Two source numbering slips corrected as before (invasive-species outcome renumbered 12.2.2.1; mining-data outcome renumbered 12.5.2.1; two truncated codes renumbered 12.10.1.1/12.12.2.1 by sub-topic position). Topic 12.3 genuinely does not exist in the source (numbering jumps 12.2→12.4), confirmed by the Scope and Sequence Chart. Rebuilt 2026-08-31 to add real term/week/reference data from a second real source, 'MINISTRY OF GENERAL EDUCATION SOCIAL SCIENCES PROVINCIAL SCHEMES OF WORK — SOUTHERN PROVINCE, GEOGRAPHY' — a province-level document (no individual teacher/school named, nothing to sanitize), covering all 3 grades × all 3 terms, cross-checked against its own clean end-of-document 'GEOGRAPHY TOPICS' Grade 12 summary (Forestry → Field Project → Wildlife/Tourism → Mining → Transport/Communication → Processing/Manufacturing → Revision). Real irregularities documented, not silently resolved: (1) this source's Grade 12 list has NO 'Agriculture in Zambia' topic at all — instead, this file's existing 12.1 (Land Tenure/Irrigation/Bad Practices/Soil Conservation) is, in this school's real practice, taught a grade earlier, under Grade 11 Term 2-3's '11.4 Agriculture in Zambia, Sub-Region and the World' (see geography_grade11.json) — both are kept, a real cross-grade discrepancy between the official CDC numbering (Grade 12) and this school's real teaching order (Grade 11), not an error to resolve; (2) 'Power and Energy in Zambia/Sub-Region' (12.7/12.8) and 'Transport and Communication in the Sub-Region' beyond landlocked-country content (part of 12.10) are not distinctly covered in this second source's Grade 12 week table either — left without added week/reference data rather than guessed; (3) genuinely new real content this file didn't have is added: Forestry's 'Types of Natural Vegetation'/'Importance of Forestry'/'Forestry Department' (12.2.0-series), Wildlife's real Kenya sub-region content (12.4.3), a new 'Geography Field Project' topic (12.3, filling the real gap where the source shows 12.3 is genuinely used at THIS school even though the original CDC syllabus skips it), and Manufacturing's real Sugar Production content (12.11.2). Each sub-topic's week_number is the real week it was first introduced.
